channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: হিপা আন্তর্জাতিক আলোকচিত্র প্রতিযোগিতায় গ্র্যান্ড প্রাইজ পেলেন বাংলাদেশের পিনু রহমান
item.description: সংযুক্ত আরব আমিরাতে আয়োজিত ১৫তম হামদান আন্তর্জাতিক আলোকচিত্র পুরস্কারে শীর্ষ স্থান দখল করেছেন বাংলাদেশি আলোকচিত্রী পিনু রহমান। ‘পরিবার’ বিষয়বস্তুর ওপর ভিত্তি করে তোলা ছবির জন্য প্রথম কোনো বাংলাদেশি হিসেবে তিনি এই সম্মাননা অর্জন করেন।

item.title: তুরস্কের আন্তালিয়ায় এরদোয়ান ও তারেক রহমানের মধ্যে দ্বিপক্ষীয় বৈঠক সম্পন্ন
item.description: মঙ্গলবার তুরস্কের স্থানীয় সময় সন্ধ্যায় আন্তালিয়ার ম্যাক্স রয়েল হোটেলে দেশটির প্রেসিডেন্ট রিসেপ তাইয়েপ এরদোয়ানের সঙ্গে বৈঠক করেছেন বাংলাদেশের প্রধানমন্ত্রী তারেক রহমান। প্রায় ৩০ মিনিট স্থায়ী এই আলোচনায় দুই দেশের পররাষ্ট্রমন্ত্রীসহ উচ্চপদস্থ প্রতিনিধিরা উপস্থিত ছিলেন।

item.title: জ্বালানি তেল মাপে কম দেওয়ায় ঢাকার এক ফিলিং স্টেশনকে ৫ লাখ টাকা জরিমানা
item.description: কাফরুল এলাকার একটি পেট্রলপাম্পে প্রতি ১০ লিটার অকটেন ও ডিজেলে ৫৩০ মিলিলিটার পর্যন্ত কম দেওয়ার প্রমাণ পাওয়ায় ৫ লাখ টাকা জরিমানা করেছে বিএসটিআই। মঙ্গলবার এক নিয়মিত তদারকি অভিযানে এই জালিয়াতি ধরা পড়ে।

item.title: অমর্ত্য সেনের জন্মবার্ষিকী সভায় সাংস্কৃতিক বহুত্ববাদ নিয়ে আলোচনা
item.description: বাঙালির পরিচয় কোনো নির্দিষ্ট ধর্ম বা ভাষায় সীমাবদ্ধ নয় বলে মত দিয়েছেন ‘বাঙলার পাঠশালা ফাউন্ডেশন’ আয়োজিত সভার বক্তারা। মঙ্গলবার অমর্ত্য সেনের ৯৩তম জন্মবার্ষিকী উপলক্ষে আয়োজিত এই ভার্চ্যুয়াল বৈঠকে উগ্র আত্মপরিচয় থেকে উদ্ভূত সংঘাত নিয়ে উদ্বেগ প্রকাশ করা হয়।

item.title: সৌরবিদ্যুৎ প্রকল্প দ্রুত করতে সংসদে নতুন বিল পেশ, ই-জিপি বাধ্যতামূলক নয়
item.description: জাতীয় সংসদে ‘বিশেষ সৌরবিদ্যুৎ স্থাপন বিল, ২০২৬’ উত্থাপন করা হয়েছে, যার লক্ষ্য হলো এই খাতের প্রকল্পগুলো দ্রুত বাস্তবায়ন করা। এই আইনের অধীনে বিদ্যুৎ কেন্দ্র স্থাপনের জন্য ইলেকট্রনিক গভর্নমেন্ট প্রকিউরমেন্ট (ই-জিপি) পদ্ধতি অনুসরণ করার বাধ্যবাধকতা থাকবে না।

item.title: December 10 marks the end of Sony's PlayStation Plus app for PC
item.description: Sony is terminating its PC-based PlayStation Plus application next month, citing a small user base. The service, which enabled Premium members to stream games on PC, will officially cease operations on December 10.

item.title: Oura acquires Counsel Health for $625 million following IPO delay
item.description: Oura has announced the $625 million acquisition of AI healthcare startup Counsel Health. The move comes shortly after the wearable technology company indefinitely paused its planned $2.2 billion public offering.

item.title: Proposal suggests moving IPL schedule
item.description: Former administrator Lalit Modi suggested shifting the Indian Premier League to begin in January or adopting a structured October through April timeframe, arguing the tournament has earned scheduling influence.

item.title: পশ্চিম জুরাইনে বাসা থেকে নারীর মরদেহ উদ্ধার, স্বামী নিখোঁজ
item.description: রাজধানীর পশ্চিম জুরাইনে একটি ভাড়া করা ফ্ল্যাটের বিছানা থেকে সূচনা আক্তার নামের এক নারীর নিথর দেহ উদ্ধার করেছেন তার স্বজনরা। নিহতের স্বামী মুঠোফোনে মৃত্যুর খবর জানিয়ে চলে যাওয়ার পর পরিবারের সদস্যরা সেখানে গিয়ে মরদেহ দেখতে পান।

item.title: Yamuna River Cruise Launched in Capital to Promote Tourism
item.description: Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal launched a new river cruise service in New Delhi. The initiative aims to enhance river-focused tourism along the Yamuna River above the Wazirabad barrage.

item.title: Florida court lifts restrictions on Sydonie Mansion event venue
item.description: An appeals court in Florida overturned a ban prohibiting the Sydonie Mansion from using chainsaws and firearms near adjacent residents. The historic property is currently involved in ongoing legal battles with neighbors over noise and nuisance complaints.

item.title: US Senate moves forward with major energy infrastructure legislation
item.description: Lawmakers advanced a bipartisan measure requiring data centers to cover infrastructure expenses. Conservation organizations argued the legislation does not go far enough.

item.title: Suvendu Adhikari attends Kali Puja hosted by Babun Banerjee
item.description: Politician Suvendu Adhikari visited the Kali Puja celebration held by Babun Banerjee, the estranged brother of Mamata Banerjee. Babun Banerjee has maintained his political alignment with the BJP following shifts in West Bengal.

item.title: SpaceX unveils Starlink Mini 2 featuring a swappable battery
item.description: SpaceX introduced an updated version of its portable satellite internet hardware that includes a removable battery alongside the built-in dish and router. The laptop-sized device was revealed to select users through ordering invitations on social media.

item.title: Legal dispute ensues after ex-employee buys unclaimed $12.8m lottery ticket
item.description: Former convenience store manager Robert Gawlitza is permitted to contest ownership of a $12.8 million winning lottery ticket left behind by a patron. The retail chain contends the slip should not have been sold to the staff member.

item.title: American service member detained in London over suspected Russian espionage
item.description: Counterterrorism officers in England apprehended a United States Army soldier on Tuesday. Authorities suspect the individual was involved in espionage activities connected to Russia.

item.title: Individual in Batman costume scales cathedral to retrieve stolen purse
item.description: A person wearing a Batman costume pursued a suspected thief and climbed a cathedral wall. The individual successfully recovered a stolen handbag during the pursuit.

item.title: Study reveals 82 percent of tech park commuters use personal vehicles
item.description: Data from technology districts indicates that the vast majority of commuters rely on private automobiles. Meanwhile, only two percent of workers utilize public transit options.

item.title: Unesco: Female Higher Ed Enrollment Rises Amid Rural School Gaps
item.description: A Unesco report shows women leading in higher education enrollment. However, a significant disparity between rural and urban areas continues to negatively impact schoolgirls.

item.title: PSI Leverages Advanced AI to Tackle Quantum Computing Mysteries
item.description: Physical Sciences Inc. utilized an unreleased Anthropic artificial intelligence model to solve a quantum computing problem that researchers pursued for nearly twenty years.

item.title: BAPA Objects to Transfer of Gulshan Central Park Management
item.description: The Bangladesh Poribesh Andolon expressed strong concern over handing park management to the Gulshan Youth Club. BAPA alleged that the club has previously occupied park land unlawfully.

item.title: Concerns Raised Over the Dissolution of the Kurian Joseph Committee
item.description: Critics argue that the dismantling of the Justice Kurian Joseph Committee was unjustified. Observers note that India's federal framework could have gained value from its work.

item.title: Palestinian Teen Killed During Israeli Military Raid in West Bank
item.description: Israeli troops shot and killed a 14-year-old boy during a raid in the West Bank village of Burqa. In a separate incident, settlers attacked a woman close to Hebron.

item.title: Vehicle Arson Cannot Destabilize Nation, Says Home Minister
item.description: Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed stated that torching a few vehicles under the cover of night fails to destabilize the political environment. He made these remarks on November 10 during the fourth session of parliament.

item.title: Turkish and Bangladeshi Leaders Hold Bilateral Talks in Antalya
item.description: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and Prime Minister Tarique Rahman held a bilateral meeting in Antalya. The discussions took place on the evening of Tuesday, November 10.

item.title: PlayStation 2 Remains History's Top-Selling Video Game Console
item.description: Sony distributed more than 160 million units of the PlayStation 2 throughout its 13-year lifespan. This milestone keeps it recognized as the best-selling gaming console ever created.

item.title: US soldier detained in England over alleged Russian espionage
item.description: British counterterrorism officers apprehended an American military member close to Gloucester, England. Authorities suspect the individual engaged in spying for Russia, with British and American agencies participating in the inquiry.

item.title: Supreme Court rules individuals lack rights to grandfather's estate held by father
item.description: The Supreme Court has determined that a person holds no legal claim to paternal grandfather assets currently possessed by their father.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's pivotal role in the AI technology sector
item.description: Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang leads a premier global enterprise supplying critical hardware for artificial intelligence development. His prominent industry position connects him with major political and business leaders worldwide.

item.title: Google launches the Pixel Tag tracking device
item.description: Google has released its Pixel Tag item tracker for buyers following prior competitor offerings on Android. Revealed initially in August, the hardware integrates with Google's proprietary tracking platform and software.

item.title: Google updates Pixel 11 Pro rear light functionality
item.description: As part of the November 2026 update, Google is updating the rear light on Pixel 11 Pro handsets. The feature will now illuminate upon receiving messages from designated favorite contacts via Google Messages.

item.title: চলচ্চিত্র মুক্তি পাচ্ছে অথচ দেশের বাইরে প্রধান তারকারা
item.description: চিত্রনায়িকা মাহিয়া মাহি যুক্তরাষ্ট্রে এবং নায়ক সাইমন সাদিক দেশের বাইরে অবস্থান করলেও, তাঁদের অভিনীত 'আনন্দ অশ্রু' সিনেমাটি দেশের হলে মুক্তি পেতে চলেছে।

item.title: Reflecting on India's historical military contributions in global conflicts
item.description: An examination of history requires acknowledging the past honestly while paying tribute to the military personnel who made ultimate sacrifices in earlier conflicts.

item.title: Ukrainian drone unit defends heavily shelled city of Slovyansk
item.description: Russian shelling persists in Slovyansk, rendering the area nearly uninhabitable with under ten percent of its original residents remaining. A Ukrainian drone brigade operates in the ruined frontline municipality to provide defense.

item.title: India Dismisses US Commission Statement on Gurdwaras as Political
item.description: New Delhi has strongly dismissed recent comments by a US body regarding assaults on Sikh temples. A USCIRF commissioner had alleged online that gurdwaras and religious figures faced vigilante aggression.

item.title: OpenAI Introduces Business Profiles to Enhance ChatGPT Search
item.description: OpenAI has launched new tools for corporate entities to boost visibility on ChatGPT. This update aims to transform the AI platform into a more effective tool for consumer searches.

item.title: Eisenkot Criticizes Netanyahu Amid Unity Government Proposal
item.description: Israeli politician Eisenkot has targeted the prime minister, calling his remarks unrealistic. This followed the leader's appeal for a united administration to confront threats from Iran.

item.title: Procurement Order for Tiruchi Kamarajar Library Revoked
item.description: Authorities have called off the acquisition of books designated for the Kamarajar Grand Library. Additionally, publishers were instructed to retrieve submissions currently stored at the Tiruchi District Central Library.

item.title: New York State to Conduct Independent Evaluations of AI Systems
item.description: New York plans to independently evaluate artificial intelligence models through its research hub. State officials will verify the performance of AI developers rather than relying on self-reported data.

item.title: Google Launches $30 Pixel Tag Tracker for Android Users
item.description: Google has released the Pixel Tag, a $30 tracking device designed to help Android users locate misplaced belongings. The accessory functions similarly to Apple's AirTag.

item.title: Former Malaysian Leader Najib Razak Transferred to House Detention
item.description: Ex-Prime Minister Najib Razak has been moved from prison to serve the remainder of his sentence under house arrest. He was previously convicted over the massive 1MDB state fund embezzlement scandal.

item.title: UK Warns of Severe Impacts if Argentina Blocks Falklands Oil Venture
item.description: London stated that Falkland residents would suffer severe impacts if Buenos Aires halts an offshore petroleum initiative. The dispute over the Sea Lion project has further intensified the regional sovereignty disagreement.

item.title: Author David Walliams faces grooming accusations by multiple women
item.description: An inquiry by ITV News and The Guardian presents claims against the 55-year-old British writer. Several women accuse the author of grooming minors.

item.title: CPCB clarifies National Air Quality Index data gaps on Diwali
item.description: India's pollution control authority has addressed questions regarding missing metrics. Officials explained the structure and international standards of the NAQI.

item.title: Kochi police officer bitten by detained man during transport
item.description: A law enforcement officer in Kochi sustained hand injuries after a detained individual attacked him. The incident occurred inside a police vehicle during a medical transit.

item.title: Supreme Court directs WhatsApp to outline cybercrime prevention steps
item.description: The top court asked WhatsApp to detail actions against digital arrests. Representing the platform, Kapil Sibal noted that thousands of accounts were blocked.

item.title: Madras High Court orders FIR in public library book procurement case
item.description: Judges instructed the DVAC to register a case and freeze accounts tied to Agal Vilakku Publications. The court also called for the suspension of implicated officials.

item.title: High court orders police case and freezes publisher accounts over scam
item.description: The ruling followed a contempt petition addressing non-compliance with prior library book procurement guidelines. Authorities were ordered to freeze publisher bank assets.

item.title: UK Privy Council strikes down Trinidad and Tobago gay sex ban
item.description: London judges invalidated legislation criminalizing consensual relations between men in Trinidad and Tobago. The Privy Council serves as the nation's final appellate court.

item.title: Archana Veeramani files Madras High Court plea against SIT
item.description: The daughter of Gem Granites Veeramani alleged human rights abuses by investigators. She stated officers removed her from a flight and detained her without a warrant.

item.title: Uttar Pradesh Minor Prevents Forced Marriage via Helpline Call
item.description: Authorities intervened to halt an underage marriage in Uttar Pradesh after the teenage girl contacted a support hotline. Officials reported that the relatives signed legal documents promising to delay the wedding until she reaches adulthood.

item.title: TVK Legislator Rejects Accusations of Inappropriate Texts to Collector
item.description: A TVK legislative member has publicly refuted claims that he transmitted vulgar messages to the district collector of Kallakurichi.

item.title: Families Accept Deceased Hosur Factory Workers' Remains Following Compensation Agreement
item.description: Relatives of three employees who lost their lives at a private manufacturing unit in Hosur consented to take possession of the bodies. The decision came after they were promised insurance payouts alongside thirty lakh rupees each as financial relief.

item.title: Nvidia's Valuation Rivals Global Economies Driven by AI Dominance
item.description: Nvidia has achieved a market valuation that approaches the scale of major sovereign nations. International Monetary Fund projections for 2026 indicate the firm's worth would place it fourth globally, trailing solely the United States, China, and Germany.

item.title: Bambu Lab P2S Combo 3D Printer Receives $100 Discount
item.description: The Bambu Lab P2S Combo 3D printer is available at a reduced price of $649 through December 1st. This model is recognized for minimizing filament jams and nozzle blockages.

item.title: Minister Emphasizes Tamil Hymns During Kandasashthi Celebrations
item.description: A government minister instructed departmental temples to have Odhuvars recite traditional Tamil religious texts, including Kandasashthi kavacham, Thirupugazh, and Thirumurai.

item.title: Washington Skips United Nations Human Rights Evaluation Again
item.description: The United Nations Human Rights Council postponed the United States human rights assessment to January after Washington declined to participate in the scheduled session.

item.title: প্রতিদিনের তওবা ও ক্ষমা প্রার্থনার গুরুত্ব
item.description: পাপের কারণে ইবাদতে অনীহা ও মানসিক শান্তি নষ্ট হতে পারে। তবে তওবা করার মাধ্যমে বান্দার জন্য আল্লাহর ক্ষমার দরজা সর্বদা উন্মুক্ত থাকে।

item.title: Author David Walliams denies accusations of grooming minor girls
item.description: At age 55, children's writer and comedian David Walliams has rejected claims that he leveraged his celebrity status to groom young girls.

item.title: PCB shifts second Test from Lahore to Rawalpindi due to heavy smog
item.description: Severe air pollution has led the PCB to move the upcoming second Test match. Consequently, Pakistan and Sri Lanka will stay at the current venue.
